# iosxe_voice_class_sip_options_keepalive (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class SIP Options Keepalive configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_sip_options_keepalive" "example" {
  tag               = 200
  description       = "ITSP keepalive profile"
  up_interval       = 60
  down_interval     = 30
  retry             = 5
  transport_tcp     = true
  transport_tcp_tls = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip-options-keepalive tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Description of a options-keepalive profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `down_interval` (Number) OPTIONS keepalive timer interval for DOWN endpoint
  - Range: `5`-`1200`
- `retry` (Number) Retry count for OPTIONS keepalive retransmission
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Put sip-options-keepalive to inactive state
- `sip_profiles` (String) Voice Class SIP Profiles
- `transport_tcp` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - TCP
- `transport_tcp_tls` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - TLS over TCP
- `transport_udp` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - UDP
- `up_interval` (Number) OPTIONS keepalive timer interval for UP endpoint
  - Range: `5`-`1200`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_sip_options_keepalive.example "<tag>"
```
